name: Wexlab Product Grid for WooCommerce
author: wpexpertlab

sections.description:
Wexlab Product Grid for WooCommerce is an independent widget set by WP Expert Lab that lets you display WooCommerce content inside Elementor using fully customizable widgets. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Elementor.

Free Widgets (Fully Functional)

  • Product Grid – Display Latest, Featured, On Sale, or Best Selling products in a customizable grid
  • Product Categories – Show your WooCommerce categories in a clean grid layout
  • Product Search – A simple, styled search box for finding products

Features

  • Choose 2, 3, or 4 column layouts
  • Show or hide product image, title, price, rating, and add to cart button
  • Responsive – looks great on all screen sizes
  • Full style controls: colors, typography, padding, border radius, box shadow
  • Lightweight – no bloat, fast loading
  • Works with Elementor free version
  • Compatible with all WooCommerce themes

Additional Pro Widgets Shown

This plugin also displays 13 premium widgets in the Elementor panel so users can see what is available in the full product:

  • Smart Product Filters (Ajax)
  • Product Grid Pro (Masonry, Load More)
  • Product Carousel Pro
  • Quick View Popup
  • Product Tabs (Featured/Sale/Latest)
  • Product Comparison + Sticky Bar
  • Product Swatches
  • Recently Viewed Products
  • Product Badges Customizer
  • Product Hotspots
  • Product Bundle Showcase
  • Product Recommendations Engine
  • Store Locator (Google Maps Embed)

These widgets show an informational upgrade notice only and contain no functional code in this free version. Full functionality is available in a separate Pro product sold on our website.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • WooCommerce store owners who use Elementor
  • Freelancers building client eCommerce websites
  • Developers who need clean product display widgets
  • Anyone who wants to show products, categories, or search on any page inside Elementor

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • Elementor (free version works) – required, not affiliated with this plugin
  • WooCommerce 5.0+ – required, not affiliated with this plugin
  • PHP 7.2+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wexlab-product-grid-for-woocommerce/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and active
  4. Edit any page with Elementor
  5. Search for “Product Grid”, “Product Categories”, or “Product Search” in the widget panel under Wexlab Widgets category
  6. Drag the widget to your page and configure it
sections.faq:
Is this plugin made by WooCommerce or Elementor?

No. Wexlab Product Grid for WooCommerce is an independent third-party plugin created by WP Expert Lab. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to WooCommerce or Elementor in any way.

Does this plugin work with the free version of Elementor?

Yes! This plugin works with the free version of Elementor. No Elementor Pro required.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

What are the widgets with “(PRO)” in their name?

These are informational placeholders showing additional widgets available in our separate premium product. They display an upgrade notice and link, and do not include functional code in this free version.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes. This plugin is compatible with all WooCommerce-ready themes including Astra, GeneratePress, Blocksy, OceanWP, Storefront, and more.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin loads only a small CSS file on the frontend and uses efficient WordPress queries.

Where can I get support?

For support, please use the WordPress.org support forum.
